sentences.en: I don't know how, but they got a duplicate key.
sentences.zh: 不知是怎么回事，他们得到了一把备用钥匙。

sentences.en: This sentence has been deleted because it was a duplicate.
sentences.zh: 因为这句话重复了，所以被删除了。

sentences.en: Every Tatoeba sentence is unique, because any duplicates get deleted.
sentences.zh: 每个塔奥贝塔语句都是唯一的，因为任何重复的都会被删除。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：du（两，双）+plic（重叠）+ ate→重复第二份→复制
